'''Dancer One''' was a [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] that [[Syal Antilles]] was assigned in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. She used the callsign while piloting an [[Aleph-class starfighter|Aleph fighter]] during a battle near Corellia, where she was called to escort [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] through the war zone.
